# Shaun Cedric Thomas

> Director of Partner Marketing at GetSmarter (a 2U brand). Senior member of the partner marketing team managing relationships with global higher-education and industry partners including UCT, MIT, Yale, LSE, Harvard, Cambridge, IBM, and Microsoft. Master of Marketing, peer-reviewed researcher, and part-time university lecturer based in Cape Town, South Africa.

## About

Shaun Cedric Thomas is a marketing leader with over a decade of experience in performance, growth, and partner marketing. He currently serves as Director of Partner Marketing at GetSmarter (a 2U brand), where he is a senior member of the team managing the relationships between the company and a portfolio of world-class university and industry partners.

Previously, as Manager of Performance Marketing, Shaun helped oversee an annual advertising portfolio in excess of USD $50 million across paid search, paid social, programmatic, and partner channels. He has held progressive roles at GetSmarter / 2U since 2020, working with prestigious institutions including the University of Cape Town (UCT), Massachusetts Institute of Technology (MIT), Yale University, London School of Economics (LSE), Harvard University, the University of Cambridge, IBM, and Microsoft.

Shaun holds a Master of Marketing from Cape Peninsula University of Technology (CPUT), where he also serves as Chair of the Marketing Advisory Committee, a member of the Industry Advisory Board, and a part-time lecturer.

## Writing & Thought Leadership

Shaun publishes thought pieces on marketing leadership, higher-education marketing, attribution and analytics, AI in marketing, and career development.

Published articles:

- "Combating racism, prejudice, and bias: a perspective from a person of colour" (22 May 2023). A personal essay on navigating racial bias and microaggressions in professional spaces. Discusses the courage and resilience needed to challenge discrimination, the cost of authenticity when a person of colour refuses to suppress their identity to fit the status quo, and the importance of communication over confrontation in building genuinely inclusive workplaces. Available at: https://shauncedricthomas.com/writing/combating-racism-prejudice-bias/

- "Tarot cards: discovering the surprising link between tarot and digital marketing" (10 May 2023). A creative exploration of unexpected parallels between tarot symbolism and digital marketing strategy. Covers the Fool card as a metaphor for customer journey mapping, tarot archetypes (Magician, High Priestess, Emperor) as inspiration for brand personas, and the Wheel of Fortune as a lesson in adaptability. Available at: https://shauncedricthomas.com/writing/tarot-and-digital-marketing/

- "GPT-4: A leap forward, exploring its enhanced capabilities" (23 March 2023). An early analysis of GPT-4's advancements over GPT-3.5 covering language understanding, complex question answering, creative output, mathematical and scientific reasoning, code generation, multimodal vision capabilities, and improved safety mechanisms. Also discusses areas where ChatGPT still needed improvement: contextual neutrality, user understanding, external integrations, long-term memory, and reducing hallucination. Available at: https://shauncedricthomas.com/writing/gpt-4-a-leap-forward/
